hypotheses.justification: This follows from `coordinate_apply`: for each t, `B t` is the function `w ↦ coordinate t w`, which is continuous because `coordinate t : StrongDual ℝ W`. Since W has its Borel measurable space, a continuous real-valued function is strongly measurable. Thus hsm can be derived and supplied to the existing proof; the conclusion and all degenerate cases are unchanged.
